name: What is cool roofing, and how does it help?

mainEntity.name: What is cool roofing, and how does it help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cool roofs with high solar reflectance (white coatings, tiles, metal) reduce roof temperatures by 50°F, cutting cooling loads 10-15% and extending roof life.
